status: Fixed after file/metadata/coverage inspection, before new score-reference or score-response associations; not preregistration
scores: Nine existing sets; ssGSEA ES, within-sample ranks; rank-standardized PCA with positive summed loadings; minimum 80% gene coverage

CPTAC.population: Clinical patient intersection with RNA and protein; exclude CAT metadata row
CPTAC.primary: Spearman RNA PC1 versus recorded CD3_IHC_count, complete cases
CPTAC.secondary: PC1 versus PTPRC protein; partial rank PC1 versus prespecified protein state panel adjusting recorded CD3 IHC
CPTAC.state_selection: Exclude all nine-signature overlap genes and proteins absent or measured in <80% of matched patients; require >=3 retained proteins; mean standardized protein abundance, complete cases
CPTAC.uncertainty: Patient bootstrap refits ranks/PCA, panel standardization and residuals; percentile 95% CI; BH across three planned association tests
CPTAC.interpretation: Orthogonal measurement association only, not ICI efficacy validation or proof of cell-intrinsic activation

GSE284162.population: All 12 unique baseline patients; author MPR labels; 4 yes and 8 no
GSE284162.preprocessing: Sum duplicate gene symbols, remove all-zero rows, log1p CPM, ssGSEA ES
GSE284162.analysis: AUC with higher scores predicting MPR; two-sided exact label permutation on abs(AUC-0.5), unrestricted and within platform preserving observed positive counts; BH within three tests for each permutation family
GSE284162.uncertainty: 2000 outcome-stratified patient bootstrap, refit outcome-blind PCA; percentile AUC CI; no fitted supervised multivariable model
GSE284162.limitations: Small chemotherapy plus ICI cohort; imbalanced platform labels (1/6 versus 3/6 MPR); globally distinct patients not conclusively verified; descriptive external axis refit is not validation of a transported predictor
